summary_en: This Phase 1/1b study tests CPX-351 (Vyxeos) combined with gemtuzumab ozogamicin in newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia. Vyxeos is given as a fixed dose of 44 mg/m2 daunorubicin and 100 mg/m2 cytarabine on days 1, 3 and 5, and gemtuzumab ozogamicin is given at 3 mg/m2 on a schedule that depends on dose level: day 1 only, days 1 and 4, or days 1, 4 and 7. The study measures safety and aims to find the maximum tolerated dose and recommended Phase 2 dose.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/1b prueba CPX-351 (Vyxeos) combinado con gemtuzumab ozogamicina en leucemia mieloide aguda de diagnóstico reciente. Vyxeos se administra en dosis fija de 44 mg/m2 de daunorrubicina y 100 mg/m2 de citarabina los días 1, 3 y 5, y gemtuzumab ozogamicina se administra a 3 mg/m2 con un esquema que depende del nivel de dosis: solo el día 1, los días 1 y 4, o los días 1, 4 y 7. El estudio mide la seguridad y busca la dosis máxima tolerada y la dosis recomendada para fase 2.
who_for: Adults aged 18 to 70 years with newly diagnosed acute myeloid leukemia, any risk by ELN 2017 criteria.
Myeloblasts that express CD33, shown by flow cytometry or immunohistochemistry.
ECOG performance status of 2 or less and eligible for intensive chemotherapy as judged by the treating physician.
Adequate heart function, with ejection fraction of at least 50%.
Hydroxyurea allowed for cell reduction until day 1 of study treatment.
not_for: Known current, clinically active leukemia in the central nervous system.
Known FLT3 ITD or FLT3 TKD mutation.
Active hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection, or severe liver disease.
Prior AML treatment other than hydroxyurea or leukapheresis.
